name: Maw of Lorkhaj
summary: The Maw of Lorkhaj is a desecrated Khajiiti temple in Reaper's March. It was known as the "Temple of Seven Riddles" prior to its occupation by the Dro-m'Athra. Just outside the entrance to the temple is a small hub with two merchants, crafting stations and a cooking fire. There are also some members of the Twilight Cantors nearby, and a few monks that have been afflicted by the Bent Dance. Adara'hai can be found in front of the entrance to the temple; she will request your help in dealing with the invading dro'm-Athra. You will receive The Rid-Thar's Moon Pearls along with your other rewards after defeating the Fang of Lorkhaj with Hard Mode engaged.

achievements.name: Maw of Lorkhaj: Moons' Champion
achievements.description: Complete all achievements related to defeating Rakkhat, Fang of Lorkhaj in Veteran Maw of Lorkhaj.

achievements.name: Maw of Lorkhaj Conqueror
achievements.description: Defeat Rakkhat, Fang of Lorkhaj and his legions of dro-m'Athra in Veteran Maw of Lorkhaj.

achievements.name: Maw of Lorkhaj Difficult Mode
achievements.description: Defeat Rakkhat after empowering him at the lunar shrines in Veteran Maw of Lorkhaj.

achievements.name: Maw of Lorkhaj: Fang Focused
achievements.description: Defeat Rakkhat in Veteran Maw of Lorkhaj, with at least three dro-m'Athra Dreadstalkers still alive.

achievements.name: Maw of Lorkhaj: Void Avoided
achievements.description: Defeat Rakkhat in Veteran Maw of Lorkhaj, with a maximum of two players ever being afflicted by the Breath of Lorkhaj.

achievements.name: Maw of Lorkhaj: Two-Moons Dance
achievements.description: In Veteran Maw of Lorkhaj, force Rakkhat into his final phase within two lunar cycles, then defeat him.

achievements.name: Maw of Lorkhaj Completed
achievements.description: Drive the dro-m'Athra back to the void and close the Maw of Lorkhaj in Normal Mode.

achievements.name: Maw of Lorkhaj: Shadow Slayer
achievements.description: Defeat 25 Void Callers in the Maw of Lorkhaj.

achievements.name: Maw of Lorkhaj: Stainless Souls
achievements.description: Defeat Rakkhat without anyone dying while afflicted by the Breath of Lorkhaj.

achievements.name: Maw of Lorkhaj: Spotless Triumph
achievements.description: Complete Veteran Maw of Lorkhaj without suffering a group member death.

achievements.name: Maw of Lorkhaj: Unchained Ambush
achievements.description: Use both chain switches within ten seconds in Veteran Maw of Lorkhaj, then defeat the dro-m'Athra invaders.

achievements.name: Time Trial: Maw of Lorkhaj
achievements.description: Complete Veteran Maw of Lorkhaj within a time limit of 40 minutes. Your trial begins when you cross the threshold of the Temple of Seven Riddles.

notes: This trial is commonly abbreviated as "MoL".
To celebrate the Thieves Guild DLC's one year anniversary, Defiled Whisker drops were temporarily doubled as part of the Thieves Guild Anniversary Event.
The reward chests for defeating bosses here have a chance to contain Defiled Whiskers.
Even though this trial is in an Alliance Zone region, access to the Thieves Guild DLC is required to run it.
You will receive The Rid-Thar's Moon Pearls for defeating Rakkhat with hard mode active.
